criteria.requirement: Implement icalendar.fingerprint.calendar_fingerprint with declared schema/profile/algorithm/ignore fields. Canonicalize via actual sorted property/parameter serialization plus order-independent child-component multisets, preserving duplicates, DATE-vs-floating-vs-aware values, unknown extensions and repeated-property value order. Default include all fields; allow only explicit DTSTAMP/CREATED/LAST-MODIFIED omission, reject unsupported profiles/depth budgets and business-field omission. Same permitted folding/property/component reorder must hash equally, real summary/start/extension changes differently, and input objects must remain unchanged. Do not claim a bare hash of existing sorted serialization is a new semantic profile.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
